p: blessing: This blessing contains not only a simple prayer, but an assurance of the effect of it.
thousands of saints: Meaning, infinite angels.
all his saints are in thy: Hebrew, his saints, that is, the children of Israel.
inheritance of the congregation of Jacob: To us and our successors.
Reuben live: Reuben will be one of the tribes of God's people, though for his sin his honour is diminished, and his family but small.
sufficient for him: Signifying, that he would barely obtain Jacob's promise, Ge 49:8.
I have not seen him: He preferred God's glory to all natural affection, Ex 28:30.
through the loins of them that: He declares that the ministers of God have many enemies, and therefore need to be prayed for.
dwell in safety by him: Because the temple would be built in Zion, which was in the tribe of Benjamin, he shows that God would dwell with him there.
bush: Which was God appearing to Moses, Ex 3:2.
going out: In thy prosperous voyages on the sea, Ge 49:13.
they shall suck of the abundance: The tribe of Zebulun.
lawgiver: So the portion of the Gadites, and others on this side of the Jordan was God's, though it was not so known.
the west and the south: Meaning, near the sea.
iron and brass: You will be strong or, your country full of metal. It seems that Simeon is left out, because he was under Judah, and his portion of his inheritance, Jos 19:9.
the fountain of Jacob shall be: Who was plentiful in issue as a fountain.
thine enemies shall be found liars: Your enemies for fear shall lie and pretend to be in subjection.
